alerts.header: Downtown [E] trains are rerouted via Roosevelt Island from Queens to Manhattan.
alerts.description:
What's happening?
We are performing track maintenance near Queens Plaza.

Service Change:
Downtown [E] trains are rerouted via Roosevelt Island from 36 St to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr and then on the [F] line to W 4 St-Wash Sq.

Travel Alternatives: 
For service to/from Queens Plaza, use nearby Queensboro Plaza  ([7]/[N])  or 21 St-Queensbridge ([F]) station. 
For service to/from Court Sq-23 St, use the [7] trains. 
For service to/from Lexington Av/53 St, use [4][6] trains. 
For service to/from 5 Av/53 St, use nearby 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr ([D]/[F]). 
For service to/from 7 Av, use [D] trains. 
For service along 8th Ave in Manhattan, use [A] trains. 

Boarding Change: 
At W 4 St-Wash Sq board downtown [E] trains on the lower level [F] train platform. 

Planned Work Reminder: 
Queens-bound [E] trains are rerouted via the [F] line W 4 St-Wash Sq to 36 St.

definitions.position: First remaining stop in a feed report: approaching, stopped at, or about to leave. Not GPS or independently measured train location.
definitions.arrival: Future official stop-time predictions, not observed arrivals. Estimates expire with source freshness or when the predicted time passes.
definitions.scope: Assigned unambiguous E service reports in the ACE feed, not all physical trains. Other lines are not supported.
